title: 第21章 他什么档次第22章 当巧合遇见巧合
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第21章他什么档次！
（..）即便是身处争执之中，韩彦谦的目光也不由被埃尔法与众不同的大气外观所吸引。
只要是爱车的人就没法绕过这辆车，毕竟“陆地头等舱”
的称号可不是开玩笑的，虽然有营销的成分。
但这车火热的时候，确实很少有商务车能像埃尔法这样，出厂价只是一个参考价，在别的品牌的商务车都有各种促销折扣的时候，埃尔法却一直都需要加价至少30万才能提车。
而且这车看似只是一百来万，但它实际上象征的资产地位，却早就超过了这个区间。
你买同价位的保时捷是自己开，但你买一辆这个，就意味着必须配备一個专职司机，且这绝对不可能是你仅有的豪车。
看看以前买这车的都是什么人就知道了。
明星、商务大佬、豪门世家……
正在韩彦谦短暂愣神的时候，埃尔法的驾驶位车门打开，一个身穿黑西装、戴着白手套，一看就是专业司机的中年人走了下来，魁梧的身材很有压迫感。
然后在韩彦谦更加懵逼的眼神中，司机径直走到了周望面前，以一种请示的语气说道：“周先生，要不交给我来处理吧？”
“那麻烦你了。”
周望有些意外，不知道这位司机大哥怎么会主动出面，但他还是点了点头。
然后他就看到司机回车里取下了行车记录仪，然后走到了明显有些不知所措的韩彦谦面前，举着行车记录仪说道：
“这位先生，你刚刚的一切行为都被拍摄下来了，包括你前面骚扰这位女士，以及后面对周先生动手，然后又利用自己的车辆进行碰瓷等行为。”
“不是，等等，我怎么就碰瓷了！”
韩彦谦一惊，急忙道，“明明是他……”
“伱不用跟我解释。”
司机摇着头，面色冷漠的打断了韩彦谦，“我现在会立刻打电话报警，同时联络集团的专业律师，有什么你可以和他们说。”
“别，千万别！”

韩彦谦彻底慌了神，“我不要赔偿了，我现在就走，现在就走！”
事实上在司机走到周望面前，当他意识到这辆埃尔法竟然是周望的座驾的时候，韩彦谦心中就已经开始发虚了。
他能凭借着一辆宝马525在普通的大学生面前耍横，但他却绝不敢在一辆埃尔法的车主面前造次。
别说他本来就心中有鬼，就算确实全都是周望的错，他也只能乖乖的认栽。
不服？反抗？
别闹了，他才什么档次啊！
不同于不知天高地厚的年轻人，经历过社会浮沉的韩彦谦，太明白这样的人物要玩死他有多简单，哪怕是在规则之内。
见韩彦谦出现了退让的意思，司机便用征询的眼神看向了周望。
“我看可以报警，别的不好说，敲诈勒索是一定的，你这辆车的后视镜应该早就坏了吧？”
听着周望淡淡的话语，韩彦谦急的不行，也顾不得什么脸面了，他赶紧去车里拿了包印象烟出来，一边给周望和司机递烟，一边挤出笑脸，连连鞠躬。
“你们看这事闹的，我刚才想起来了，后视镜确实之前就撞过一下，赖我赖我，给记岔了，不是多大的事，咱们就没必要闹到警局去了吧？”
看着一直弯腰点头，姿态放得很低的韩彦谦，周望没有理他，只是看向了一旁的姜沫。

(..) Even in the middle of a dispute, Han Yanqian's eyes couldn't help but be attracted by Alpha's unique and majestic appearance.
As long as you are a car lover, you can't avoid this car. After all, "first class on land"
The title is no joke, although it has a marketing component.
But when the car was popular, there were indeed few commercial vehicles like Alfa. The ex-factory price was just a reference price. While other brands of commercial vehicles had various promotional discounts, Alfa always required a price increase of at least 300,000 to take delivery of the car.
Moreover, this car seems to only cost around one million, but the asset status it actually symbolizes has long exceeded this range.
If you buy a Porsche of the same price, you can drive it yourself, but if you buy this one, it means that it must be equipped with a dedicated driver, and this will definitely not be your only luxury car.
Just look at who bought this car in the past.
Celebrities, business tycoons, wealthy families...
While Han Yanqian was briefly dazed, Alfa's driver's door opened, and a middle-aged man wearing a black suit and white gloves, who looked like a professional driver, stepped out. His burly figure was very oppressive.
Then, with Han Yanqian's even more confused eyes, the driver walked straight up to Zhou Wang and said in a requesting tone: "Mr. Zhou, why don't you leave it to me?"
"Then I'm sorry to trouble you."
Zhou Wang was a little surprised. He didn't know why the driver took the initiative, but he still nodded.
Then he saw the driver return to the car and take off the dash cam, then walked up to Han Yanqian who was obviously at a loss, held up the dash cam and said:
"Sir, everything you did just now was filmed, including your harassment of this lady in the front, your attack on Mr. Zhou later, and your use of your own vehicle to engage in collisions, etc."
"No, wait, why did I mess up!"
Han Yanqian was startled and said hurriedly, "It's obviously him..."
"You don't need to explain to me."
The driver shook his head and interrupted Han Yanqian with a cold expression, "I will call the police immediately and contact the group's professional lawyers. You can tell them anything."
"No, please don't!"
Han Yanqian was completely panicked, "I don't want compensation, I'm leaving now, I'm leaving now!"
In fact, when the driver walked up to Zhou Wang and realized that the Alpha was actually Zhou Wang's car, Han Yanqian started to feel guilty.
He can use a BMW 525 to show off in front of ordinary college students, but he would never dare to make a mistake in front of the owner of an Alfa.
Not to mention that he had evil intentions in his heart, even if it was indeed Zhou Wang's fault, he could only admit defeat obediently.
Not convinced? Resist?
Stop making trouble, what level is he!
Unlike young people who don't know the heights of the world, Han Yanqian, who has experienced the ups and downs of society, understands how easy it is for such a character to kill him, even within the rules.
Seeing that Han Yanqian was showing signs of giving in, the driver looked at Zhou Wang inquiringly.
"I think we can call the police. It's hard to say anything else. Extortion is a given. The rearview mirror of your car should have been broken a long time ago, right?"
Listening to Zhou Wang's calm words, Han Yanqian was so anxious that he didn't care about his dignity anymore. He hurriedly went to the car and took out a pack of Impression cigarettes. While passing the cigarettes to Zhou Wang and the driver, he smiled and bowed repeatedly.
"Look at what happened. I just remembered it. The rearview mirror did hit me before. I forgot about it. It's not a big deal. We don't need to go to the police station, right?"
Looking at Han Yanqian who kept bending over and nodding with a very low posture, Zhou Wang ignored him and just looked at Jiang Mo aside.
